calendar.label: Fire calendar: years down, months across
calendar.noComparison: No usual level to compare with

legend.anomalySteps: Colour steps: under half the usual month, up to 0.8, up to the usual level, up to 1.25, up to twice, and twice or more.

unusual.heading: Is this unusual?

headline.above: Higher than usual for this month.
headline.near: About the usual level for this month.
headline.below: Lower than usual for this month.
headline.noHistory: Not enough past years to compare.
headline.tooEarly: Too early in the month to compare.

unusual.noHistory: Fewer than three past {month} months have a measurement here.
unusual.tooEarly: Fewer than eight days of data this month, and counts over shorter periods are biased.
unusual.medianZero: The first {month} with fire here in {years} years.

chance.heading: Chance of fire this month
chance.detail: {month} had fire in {fireYears} of {years} past years.
chance.expectedDetail: A typical {month} here, from the past years with a measurement.
chance.noHistory: No past {month} here has a measurement.

window.heading: This fire against past fires, last {days} days
window.chartLabel: Hotspots in the same days of each year
window.highest: The highest of the {of} years with a measurement.
window.rank: Number {rank} of {of} years, over the same {days} days.
window.noPast: No past year has a measurement for these {days} days.
window.estimatedNote: Years before 2012 are estimated from MODIS and marked with a bar and stripes.

reported.heading: Detected against reported
reported.countryContext: Country total, for context: the selection is smaller than the country.
reported.caption: Officially reported figures from {source}, next to what the satellites saw.
reported.noYears: The source covers this place but has published no figures yet.
reported.notComparable: The two columns count different things: a reported fire is one event, a satellite figure counts cell-days.

extremes.trendTooShort: Fewer than five complete years ({years} so far), so no trend is drawn.
extremes.trendPerDecade: change per decade, against the average year

trend.heading: Year by year
trend.noYears: No complete year has a measurement yet.
trend.lineKey: A solid line is measured, a dashed line is estimated from MODIS. The band is the lower to upper range.
trend.summary: Yearly totals from {first} to {last}, highest {max} {unit}, over {years} complete years.

satellites.heading: Raw counts per satellite
satellites.caption: What each satellite measured, with no conversion applied.
satellites.countryOnly: Per-satellite counts are held for whole countries only.
satellites.note: An empty cell means the satellite was not in orbit or not measuring.

table.heading: The months as rows
table.caption: Every month in the calendar, in {unit}.
table.zeroNote: 0 means the satellites looked and saw no fire. "no data" means there was no measurement at all.

downloads.heading: Downloads
downloads.note: Every file starts with comment lines naming the place, the dates and the sources. An empty field means no measurement; 0 means no fire seen.
downloads.pngMissing: The picture is not on screen, so it could not be saved.
downloads.pngFailed: The picture could not be turned into a PNG in this browser.

hotspot.text: One satellite reading that a patch of ground was burning when the satellite passed over.

fireDay.text: One small square of ground counted on one day with fire, added up over the area, so a long fire counts more than a brief one.

anomaly.text: How far a month sits from the usual level for that same month in past years.

frp.text: Fire radiative power, in megawatts: how much heat the fire was giving off as the satellite passed.

harmonized.text: Older and newer satellites are brought to one scale, so a change in the record is a change on the ground.

estimated.text: A month before February 2012, worked out from the older MODIS satellites, with a lower and upper bound.

noData.text: Nothing was measured. Different from 0, which means the satellites looked and saw no fire.

searchDistance.text: How far from the chosen point the app keeps readings, from 0 to 500 km.

outside.heading: See this place in official services
outside.intro: Emerge builds on these services. They are the official sources; Emerge is a research tool.
outside.firms: NASA FIRMS: live fire map, last 7 days
outside.effisStats: EFFIS: burned area against the {from} to {to} average
outside.gwisDanger: GWIS: today's fire danger map (opens on the world)
outside.wholeCountry: For the whole country, not only the selection.
